claims.text: Fine-grained entity typing involves assigning multiple semantic types to entities, rather than a single type, indicating a richer set of types.
The task is approached as a multi-label classification problem, allowing entities to be categorized into several types based on context.
Fine-grained types are drawn from a fine-grained type set, which includes a variety of semantic categories beyond coarse types.
